name: unsloth-local-codex
description: Local Codex workflow for Unsloth Studio with durable plans, goals, long-context Mac inference, and GitHub context.

interface.shortDescription: Local Codex workflow for Unsloth Studio.
interface.longDescription: Adds a reusable local workflow for Unsloth Studio: inspect GitHub ledgers, plan changes, execute durable goals, and validate Mac inference without embedding credentials.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the Unsloth v1.1 ledger and propose safe optimizations.
Plan a Mac inference change and keep explicit user settings authoritative.
Audit a DFlash or MTP change against GitHub evidence.
